title: First scripted pick run against the physical arm: dry run, whole pipeline, nothing sent
notes: Console in bench mode on the PC (arm on enx00e04c3c6376, RealSense on USB). 48 real depth frames through real YOLO, all six viewpoints, 0 commands sent, arm never energised. No cup in front of the camera, so it ended at 'no cup found from any viewpoint' — which is the correct outcome, not a failure of the path.
